note: Page weight of the built home page, without scrolling, at 1440x1000 on each day that gives a different feature (day 0 as "1440x1000") and at 390x844 on day 0. Counts are held exactly. Bytes are held exactly too, since two builds from one commit gave the same figures. Held both ways: a drop fails as a rise does.
